messages:
Marcus (VP Product): Ok team, finalizing facilitation for the annual planning offsite. Need owners for pre-read, breakout prompts, and day-of timing. Dates proposed: Jun 3-4 — any blockers?

Ava (PM): Jun 3-4 works for me. I'll own the pre-read deck + TL;DR. How long should the pre-read be? 6 slides max? :memo:

Diego (Eng): I can take the tech constraints breakout. Thinking 30m session + 15m reportback.

Sophie (Design): I'll run the customer empathy / storyboarding breakout. Will prep personas and 2 micro-scenarios.

Riley (Platform): I'll handle room infra, A/V, and remote setup (Zoom backup + Jamboard). Will bring spare mic & USB-C hub.

Marcus (VP Product): Great — owners so far: Ava (pre-read), Diego (tech), Sophie (design), Riley (ops). Need someone for data & metrics facilitation.

Harper (Growth): I'll own metrics & signals breakout. Will surface top KPIs and a shortlist of experiments to inform prioritization.

Ava (PM): Draft pre-read outline: agenda, goals + success criteria, current roadmap snapshot, 3 customer asks with impact estimates, cost/latency tradeoffs. I aim to drop link by Monday EOD.

Marcus (VP Product): Facilitation sketch: Day 1 AM — vision + top themes (40m); breakout rotation (3x30m with 15m reportbacks); Day 2 — prioritization, bets, and owners. Who co-facilitates prioritization?

Diego (Eng): I can co-facilitate prioritization with you. Recommend RICE grid to surface tradeoffs.

Sophie (Design): RICE + a silent voting round before discussion to reduce anchoring. Suggest 10m silent votes.

Harper (Growth): I'll set up the voting board in Miro and pre-seed it with baseline metrics.

Riley (Platform): For remote folks: will set up failover Zoom link and a Jamboard per breakout. Need confirmation on room A/V capacity and HDMI adaptors.

Sam (People Ops): Catering is tentatively booked. Send dietary restrictions and final headcount by next Tue. Also confirm arrival time if folks want coffee before start.

Ava (PM): I'll collect headcount and pre-read signoffs. Also will add a 15m dependency review block so teams can flag blockers.

Marcus (VP Product): Success criteria for the offsite: (1) Clear top 3 bets, (2) each bet has an owner + 2 success metrics, (3) rationale documented in the decisions doc. If everyone's good I'll lock agenda and room today.

Diego (Eng): +1 to success criteria. Request: add 15m for infra constraints and rollout considerations into the prioritization slot.

Sophie (Design): +1 to dependency and rollout discussion. Also can prepare 2 rapid prototypes for the top customer scenario.

Marcus (VP Product): Final action items: Ava — pre-read + headcount + decisions doc template; Diego — tech breakout + dependency list; Sophie — design breakout + vote facilitation; Harper — metrics board; Riley — A/V & remote; Sam — catering & on-site logistics. Ping me when those are ready. :rocket:
